scientific_integrity: A standalone exact-enumeration checker supports finite cases; the infinite result is established by a claimed elementary bijection, a dominated-convergence argument and simplex Riemann sums. Classical determinant/forest results and Dirichlet facts are acknowledged. No independent audit or external certification has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Cycle rim with n>=3; identical spoke conductance; fixed \(s>0\) at \(s/n^2\) for joint limits. Finite conditional composition law valid for any spoke t>0. No extensions to heterogeneous spokes, arbitrary rims, or growing hubs. Historical priority and independent verification remain unconfirmed.
title: Exact spoke–cut compositions in weighted wheel spanning trees and their critical spatial limit
